title: Functions
instructions: A function is a reusable mini-program with a name. You write it once and call it as many times as you want.
int add(int a, int b) means: a function named add that takes two ints (a and b) and hands back an int.
The values you pass in (a and b) are called parameters.
return sends an answer back to whoever called the function.
You call it by name: add(3, 4). The result can be caught in a variable or printed.
task: Finish the add function so it returns the sum, making the program print:  3 + 4 = 7
hint:
Hand back a + b:

    return a + b;
